cause.server: GET refuses an already owned reconciliation with CONTEST_TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE/503. Intentional P0 protection preserved.
cause.frontend: AppBootstrap cleared the authoritative DTO on unavailable, unmounting ContestScreen and its recovery poller.
cause.reproducedBeforeFix: AppBootstrap regression test failed: expected running-contest projection, received null.
cause.attributionLimit: These logs confirm the documented mechanism and time window, not an identity link between a particular browser screenshot and request. No private request bodies, IPs or identities retained.

frontend: Retain last authoritative DTO on transient error or slow read; no component remount.
One visible surface poller, including initial recovery; 2s active/3s idle, exponential backoff capped at 15s, hidden pause and focus/visible revalidation.
External refresh invalidates stale data and queues behind the owned read, preserving the 8s UI diagnostic without abandoning SQL.
Reset projection and generations on session/Player change; stale auth errors ignored; current 401 follows existing sign-out, 401/403 stop polling.
Refused action triggers a read only, never automatic mutation replay; mutation revision/idempotency guards unchanged.
Compact synchronization status in the fixed theme toolbar, full accessible label/title, no CSS or graphical lot change.
implementation.serverReason: Reducing overlap 503 without compromising the blocked-reconciliation P0 guard is not demonstrated. Fixing client continuity meets the primary objective without changing locks, transactions, scheduler or pooling.

privatePostgresql.isolation: UUID private schema, reference catalogs/metadata public read-only, private DDL and fixtures cleaned by owned helper; no public Contest QA.
privatePostgresql.coverage: Blocked reconciliation, bounded concurrent GET rejection, bootstrap reads, drained recovery, sockets/pool cleanup; lifecycle, concurrent mutations, idempotency, spectators/support, cancellation/refund, turns/timeouts/bots, rewards and rollover.

limits: 503 protection remains intentional; a GET owning new reconciliation may still wait on its SQL. No SQL deadline or cancellation claimed.
Retained projection may be stale; server exclusively validates turn, deadlines, permissions and rewards.
Recovery never overlaps an owned read; genuinely blocked initial SQL cannot be recovered by manufacturing a second request.
Per-tab deduplication only; no cross-tab leader election added.
Private automated/visual QA does not prove uninterrupted real public multiplayer sessions.
